criteria.statement: A committed worked-solutions evaluation set exists, sourced from real hard rules questions with published worked solutions.
Every case documents its source/provenance (where the question and its worked solution came from) and confirms licensing permits committing it.
The set runs through the existing eval harness infrastructure without a new runtime dependency, external call, or live prompt wiring.
npm run quality:check is unaffected by the new set -- it stays a non-gating, opt-in validation track.
